digest.component_or_area: rebar gate execution and sidecar telemetry
propositions: The sidecar channel sanitization allowlist admits gate-run limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but discards consumed counters (requests, tool_calls), recording only the ceiling and never the measurement.

Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, so plan-review preflight, plan-review mid-run, code-review preflight, code-review mid-run, and completion preflight errors record no gate consumption counters.

The completion verdict sidecar payload carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries per-call requests and a metrics block, creating asymmetry between the two gates.
Gate run consumption metrics must reach the ticket store via the sidecar channel to be answerable globally to all agents, not only locally in per-checkout usage logs.
The completion gate, despite five budget increases, remains instrumented only locally and blindly on the sidecar channel relative to plan-review gates.
